features.description: Grade Cloud Run Job: clone at BaseCommit, apply diffs, policy-confined ailang check/test with 300s per-gate and 900s job bounds; daemon only dispatches
acceptance_criteria: Fixture pass/fail diffs graded correctly
Hanging test -> ungraded(timeout) within bound
Unappliable diff -> ungraded(apply_failed)
No grading code runs in the daemon; no make targets invoked
features.notes: Mark approved 10-19: grade = mode of the existing agent executor job (AILANG_JOB_MODE=shadow_grade), not a new Cloud Run job. Coordinator sweep dispatchShadowGrades (claim CAS, stale -> grade_timeout, dispatch failure -> ungraded). Job: fetch base SHA, git apply, policy-tool check+test per module with sandbox = package dir; test --package . only where *_test.ail exist. Live smoke found two things the fake runner hid: (1) modules inside a package only resolve with the package dir as root -> per-package sandbox; (2) test --package runs only *_test.ail and exits 0 otherwise -> inline tests run per file. Also found+fixed: write-back used the expired job ctx after a timeout. Per-gate bound is policytool's 120s (tighter than the design's 300s). Deploy-key (SSH) clones not supported in grade mode yet: such repos grade as clone_failed. 19 mutants killed. Firestore list/claim verified live on dev; real-binary end-to-end opt-in test passes.

features.description: On parent PR settle: merged diff by PR number, overlap + merged-test replay; circular flag; off-Anthropic reviewer only on disagree/tie
acceptance_criteria: Settled-PR fixture updates comparison
Circular case flagged
Reviewer only on disagree/tie; unreachable -> ungraded(reviewer_unavailable)
features.notes: One stage field (grade_state) drives mechanical -> graded(wait PR) -> merged_tests -> review -> done; every job phase is a mode of the executor job (AILANG_SHADOW_PHASE). Merged-fix layer = GitHub reads in the coordinator (settledPRLookup + pulls/{n} + files), circular = merged head == primary HeadCommit, file-level Jaccard overlap (function-level overlap NOT done: AILANG hunks carry no function context). merged_tests overlays only *_test.ail from the merge commit. Reviewer reuses quorum.ResolveCaller (openai/google/ollama only; a cloud job may lack those credentials -> reviewer_unavailable, surfaces in the M7 smoke), A/B order hashed per comparison, cost via token counts x registry pricing, pre-flight cap. Verified live: gemini-4-argon picked the correct fix ($0.0019). 21 mutants killed (3 first survived and got tests: circular case, decisive-with-reviewer, settle guard).
